attributes.title: Level 4

subgroups.name: Discover

steps.text: Watch this video to learn about modifying the images in a project in the Paint and JavaScript Editors.

questions.hint: Which tool makes it easiest to quickly change the color of a large section of pixels?
questions.title:
[Select one] Which Paint Editor tool would be the best to use to change the color of a large section of an image?

A.

B.

C.

D.

E.
questions.correctResponse: The Fill tool makes it easiest to fill an entire section of pixels that are the same color with a new color.

questions.hint: Think about what changes can be made in the Paint Editor to modify an image.
questions.title: [Select all that apply] How might you change an image to make a sprite “pop” against a background of a similar color?

answers.text: Change some of the sprite’s colors
Change the size of the sprite
Change some of the background’s colors

questions.correctResponse: Changing the colors in an image or adding an outline around a sprite image are great ways to make a sprite stand out on a background image, given the limited number of colors in the MakeCode palette.

questions.title: [Open response] What are some reasons why you might want to modify an image asset?
questions.correctResponse: There are lots of great reasons for modifying an image asset, especially when it benefits the user experience of the project!

subgroups.title: Modifying Image Assets
subgroups.introduction: Watch this video to learn about modifying the images in a project in the Paint and JavaScript Editors.

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 4 of Brown Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about pixel art and how to use the asset editor to modify an existing asset. You will also use code from the Scroller and Images categories to enrich the project. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 4:

badges.title: Remixologist
badges.description: Use the paint editor to modify and remix existing pixel art image assets.

badges.title: Doppelganger
badges.description: Edit an existing asset to create multiple versions of the same image.

badges.title: Nice Change of Scenery
badges.description: Use the Scroller extension to create a background that scrolls and changes images as a sprite “walks”.

badges.title: Swatch and Learn
badges.description: Write code to get, set, and replace a pixel’s color on an image asset.

badges.title: A Refined Palette
badges.description: Use RGB values or hex color code to change the colors of the code editor’s color palette.

badges.title: Mixing it Up
badges.description: Use the Color Palette tool to change the default color palette with different colors.
